Apakah itu slippage? 📉

Anda klik beli pada 1.1050. Pesanan anda dilaksanakan pada 1.1053. Jurang 3 pip itu ialah slippage: perbezaan antara harga yang anda minta dan harga yang anda dapat.

Mengapa ia berlaku:

  • Kependaman: harga bergerak semasa pesanan anda sampai ke pasaran
  • Kecairan: jika tiada volum yang cukup pada harga anda, pesanan diisi pada harga terbaik seterusnya

Ia boleh berlaku kedua-dua arah. Slippage negatif memberi harga lebih buruk, slippage positif memberi harga lebih baik.

Untuk mengurangkannya, elakkan berdagang tepat semasa berita besar, pilih pasangan dan sesi yang cair, dan gunakan limit order apabila harga tepat penting.

At its low the stock was down 26%, its biggest intraday drop on record (Yahoo Finance). It closed at $222.76 on 29 October (Yahoo Finance data).

Good news can still send a stock lower when expectations run ahead of it.

cut.text: Are half of Nvidia's employees really worth more than $25 million? The

post.content:
Are half of Nvidia's employees really worth more than $25 million? The figure is going around again, but it is not new and it is not an official number.

It traces to an August 2025 post on X by The Kobeissi Letter: "Roughly 50% of Nvidia employees are now worth over $25 million" (Benzinga via Yahoo Finance, 5 August 2025).

Behind it is a June 2025 survey of more than 3,000 employees, about 10% of Nvidia's workforce at the time. 76% to 78% of respondents said they were millionaires, and nearly half reported a net worth above $25 million. Nvidia has not published the survey, and the figures are self-reported (Benzinga).

Jensen Huang has made a similar point about his executives: "I've created more billionaires on my management team than any CEO in the world" (July 2025, via Benzinga).

Most of that wealth is Nvidia stock, so it moves with the share price. Nvidia closed at a record $239.24 on 6 October and at $213.66 on 29 October, down 10.7%. At the 23 October close it was about 13% below its intraday record of $243.37 (Yahoo Finance data).

Sources: The Kobeissi Letter, Benzinga, Yahoo Finance. Photo: Office of the President (Taiwan), CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

post.content:
Что такое проскальзывание? 📉

Вы нажимаете «Купить» по 1.1050, а ордер исполняется по 1.1053. Эти 3 пипса и есть проскальзывание: разница между запрошенной ценой и ценой исполнения.

Почему так происходит:

  • Задержка: цена меняется, пока ордер идёт до рынка
  • Ликвидность: если на вашей цене недостаточно объёма, ордер исполняется по следующей лучшей

Проскальзывание бывает в обе стороны: отрицательное даёт цену хуже, положительное лучше.

Как его снизить: не входите в рынок прямо на выходе важных новостей, торгуйте ликвидные пары в активные сессии и используйте лимитные ордера, когда важна точная цена.

post.content:
What is slippage? 📉

You click buy at 1.1050. Your order fills at 1.1053. That 3-pip gap is slippage: the difference between the price you requested and the price you actually got.

Why it happens:

  • Latency: price moves while your order travels to the market
  • Liquidity: if there isn't enough volume at your price, you get the next best one

It can go both ways. Negative slippage fills you at a worse price, positive slippage at a better one.

To reduce it, avoid trading right into major news releases, stick to liquid pairs and active sessions, and use limit orders when the exact price matters.
